segments.name: Molecular testing services
segments.description: Develops and commercializes cell-free DNA molecular testing services in oncology, women's health and organ health for physicians, patients and laboratory partners.
segments.evidence: The Company operates one segment, the development and commercialization of molecular testing services, applying its proprietary technology in the fields of oncology, women's health and organ health.

revenueModel.text: Payers, patients and physicians pay for the company's molecular tests, sold directly and distributed globally with partner laboratories.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our tests directly and partner with other clinical laboratories to distribute our tests globally.
